rules.release_stage: The export carries Carbon's release-stage prefix (preview_, unstable_); a stage marker is not a component name, and the stable export is the row when one exists.
rules.ai_product: IBM's AI-labelling UI (AI label, slug, chat button, AI skeletons, table slug rows); product-specific, not a general design component.
rules.fluid_flavour: Carbon's Fluid field style and the FeatureFlags plumbing that gates it; one field anatomy per theme is the contract's job.
rules.mobile_system: `@carbon/react-native` is Carbon Mobile, a separate design system; this library already renders natively through react-native-web.
rules.deprecated: Upstream marks the export deprecated or a legacy alias.
rules.internal: An implementation piece Carbon exports but documents no public use for.
rules.non_ui: Hooks, contexts, enums, style objects, theme zones and error boundaries: no rendered component.
rules.product_specific: An IBM product or developer-tool pattern outside the core set this library keeps (the app switcher, the code snippet, the ibm-products rows beyond Tearsheet, PageHeader, EmptyState, Card and TagSet).
rules.css_layout: A CSS-grid utility with no React Native counterpart beyond the Grid row kept.
rules.superset_dropped: A superset addition (D6) with no reference system behind it.

rows.name: Icon
rows.description: Icon draws one semantic glyph from the theme through react-native-svg at a token size and color; it is the only icon-aware component and never substitutes a glyph; it has no upstream visual reference because icon sets are data in both reference systems; its anatomy is a Superloom decision.

rows.name: Text
rows.description: Text draws one run of text in the type set and color token a caller names, and cuts a single line with an ellipsis when asked.

rows.name: View
rows.description: View is the layout box that draws only the fill, border, radius, padding and gap token leaves a caller names; it has no upstream visual reference because neither reference system publishes a plain box, and its anatomy is a Superloom decision.

rows.name: Button
rows.description: Button draws a pressable label with an optional trailing icon in nine kinds and six sizes, each kind's fill, label, border and elevation per state from the theme's button role cells, and shows press feedback as the theme's feedback.press choice; the tonal and elevated kinds taken from its second reference are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: Checkbox
rows.description: Checkbox draws a box holding a check or mixed mark icon beside its label, with a helper or error message below, its outline, fill, mark, state layer and focus ring per state from the theme's selection role cells.

rows.name: TextInput
rows.description: TextInput draws a label, a single-line field frame and a helper or error message, with the frame drawn by feedback.field, the label placed by anatomy.label and every color, width, space and type set from the theme's field role cells.

rows.name: Select
rows.description: Select draws the field frame it shares with TextInput around a trigger that opens an option list below it, ending in the theme's own dropdown indicator glyph; every color, width, space and type set of the frame comes from the theme's field role cells.

rows.name: IconButton
rows.description: IconButton is a square button that shows one icon token and a tooltip label.

rows.name: TextArea
rows.description: TextArea draws a label, a multi-line field frame of `rows` value lines and a helper or error message, with an optional character counter placed by anatomy.field_counter; the frame is drawn by feedback.field, the label placed by anatomy.label and every color, width, space and type set from the theme's field role cells plus the text_area member cells.

rows.name: Dropdown
rows.description: Dropdown draws the select family's field frame around a trigger that opens an option list drawn on the theme's list role cells, turning its indicator while open and marking the selected item as anatomy.list_selected_mark says; every color, width, space and type set of the frame comes from the theme's field role cells.

rows.name: RadioButton
rows.description: RadioButton draws a labeled radio: a ring the theme sizes with control.radio_* member cells beside the selection family's outline, fill, layer and focus cells, with a dot drawn when checked; grouped radios share one selection with roving tab index.

rows.name: Toggle
rows.description: Toggle draws a labeled switch: a track and a sliding handle whose size follows anatomy.switch_handle, an optional checked mark and state text as anatomy.switch_state_text says, and every track, handle, outline, layer and focus color from the theme's switch role cells.

rows.name: Tag
rows.description: Tag draws a non-interactive pill holding an optional leading icon and one line of text, its container, label, icon and outline from the theme's tag role cells; a type prop picks one of the theme's ten hue cells; it is a molecule because it composes Icon.

rows.name: Tabs
rows.description: Tabs draws a row of tab labels on a track with roving focus; the selected tab draws the theme's indicator as its own bottom edge and the contained variant seats each label by the theme's tab_contained_* cells.

rows.name: Menu
rows.description: Menu is a list of menu items and separators that opens at a point, roves focus over the arrows and closes on Escape, Tab, outside press or choice.

rows.name: Modal
rows.description: Modal is a dialog on a scrim layer: a header, a body, an actions row and a close button, with Escape, focus trapping and outside-press dismissal.

rows.name: ToastNotification
rows.description: ToastNotification is a status band: a marker and status icon, a title, a subtitle, an optional caption and action, and a close button.

rows.name: ProgressBar
rows.description: ProgressBar draws a labeled track with a determinate or indeterminate indicator and a helper or status line, the indeterminate motion chosen by anatomy.progress_indeterminate and every color, height and radius from the theme's progress role cells; it is a molecule because it composes Icon for its status marks.

rows.name: Tooltip
rows.description: Tooltip is a short label on a bubble beside the element it describes, opening after a delay on hover or focus (on press where there is no hover), placed against its anchor and flipped to stay in view.

rows.name: OverlayHost
rows.description: OverlayHost mounts once at the app root and owns the ordered overlay layer stack that lets an overlay escape its parent's bounds on a native platform; it has no upstream visual reference because neither reference system publishes a layer host, and its anatomy is a Superloom decision.

rows.name: AspectRatio
rows.description: AspectRatio sizes its box to one of nine width-to-height ratios through the platform's own aspect-ratio layout and draws nothing else; a text child renders through the Text atom.

rows.name: ButtonSet
rows.description: ButtonSet lays out buttons from item data in a row, or a column when stacked, each sharing the row up to the set's item width with the theme's separator line and gap between them; a fluid set orders its buttons by kind and stacks when its container is narrower than its items' floor; the second system has no button set, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: ButtonSkeleton
rows.description: ButtonSkeleton draws the skeleton placeholder at the button's height for its size, in the button's corner and the skeleton button width; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: ComboButton
rows.description: ComboButton joins a primary action Button and an icon button that opens a Menu of further actions, its chevron turning while the menu is open, the action no narrower than the combo floor less the trigger and no wider than the combo ceiling; the second system has no split button, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: DangerButton
rows.description: DangerButton draws a Button of the danger kind whatever kind it is given.

rows.name: PrimaryButton
rows.description: PrimaryButton draws a Button of the primary kind unless it is given another kind.

rows.name: SecondaryButton
rows.description: SecondaryButton draws a Button of the secondary kind unless it is given another kind.

rows.name: Divider
rows.description: Divider draws a horizontal rule of the theme's divider width and color, inset at either end by the divider inset when asked; it has no upstream visual reference, so its values are a Superloom decision from the primary system's own scale.

rows.name: IconSkeleton
rows.description: IconSkeleton is the icon family's export of the placeholder SkeletonIcon draws, at the smallest icon size; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: Link
rows.description: Link draws a pressable run of text in the theme's link colors for rest, hover, press, visited and disabled, underlined while hovered, focused or pressed and always when inline, in three type sizes with an optional trailing icon; the second system has no link, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: SkeletonIcon
rows.description: SkeletonIcon draws the skeleton placeholder at the smallest icon size; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: SkeletonPlaceholder
rows.description: SkeletonPlaceholder draws a box in the theme's skeleton container color with a shimmer sweeping across it in the skeleton shimmer color, sized by its props or the placeholder size; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: SkeletonText
rows.description: SkeletonText draws one skeleton line of the theme's text height, a heading-height line, or a paragraph of lines whose widths step back by a fixed sequence, each followed by the skeleton text gap; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: InlineLoading
rows.description: InlineLoading draws a status mark beside a status text - the small Loading while active, a success or error glyph once settled, nothing while inactive - in the inline-loading cells, reporting a finished status through onSuccess after its delay; the second system has no inline loading row, so its values there are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: Loading
rows.description: Loading draws a spinner whose arc turns in the theme's loading_indicator color on the loading size square - the small form with a loading_track circle - and, with the default overlay, mounts it centered on a full-viewport loading_scrim dialog in the overlay order; anatomy.loading_motion picks the turning svg ring or the second system's half-masked bordered-circle arc.

rows.name: ProgressIndicator
rows.description: ProgressIndicator lays its steps out in order as a list, mounting each with its complete or current state from currentIndex and the indicator's vertical, spaceEqually and onChange - the primary's clone math; the second system has no step indicator, so its values there are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: ProgressIndicatorSkeleton
rows.description: ProgressIndicatorSkeleton draws the indicator's skeleton form - the primary's fixed four incomplete steps, each the dashed glyph, a label-sized skeleton block and the connector line on the step's geometry; the second system has no skeleton primitives, so its values there are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: ProgressStep
rows.description: ProgressStep draws one step of a ProgressIndicator - a state glyph beside the label and an optional secondary line over the connector line, the label underlining while a clickable step is hovered or pressed - and must be composed inside ProgressIndicator; the second system has no step part, so its values there are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: DismissibleTag
rows.description: DismissibleTag draws a Tag with a trailing close seat - a pressable cross in the tag cells that fires onClose - and reports itself as a dismissible control; it is a molecule because it composes Tag and IconButton.

rows.name: OperationalTag
rows.description: OperationalTag draws a Tag as an action - the whole pill is pressable, its text reading the interactive cells and the pressed state the active layer cell, firing onClick; it is a molecule because it composes Tag.

rows.name: SelectableTag
rows.description: SelectableTag draws a Tag as a toggle - pressable, aria-pressed, with a selected-mark seat mounted under every template that draws the mark only where the theme's selected-mark anatomy shows it, its pressed state reading the selectable active layer; it is a molecule because it composes Tag.

rows.name: TagSkeleton
rows.description: TagSkeleton draws the tag's skeleton form - a pill-sized skeleton block on the tag's height and radius cells - as a stand-in while a tag loads.

rows.name: CheckboxGroup
rows.description: CheckboxGroup gathers checkboxes under a legend in a vertical stack, drawing the group's invalid edge on every member and the helper or error message below while a disabled group disables every member; the second system has no checkbox group, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: CheckboxSkeleton
rows.description: A label-only loading bar with the checkbox row's empty box inset.

rows.name: Form
rows.description: Form groups a set of fields into one form.

rows.name: FormGroup
rows.description: FormGroup gathers related fields under a legend, disabled or invalid as one, and must be composed inside Form.

rows.name: FormItem
rows.description: FormItem stacks one field's parts in a column.

rows.name: FormLabel
rows.description: FormLabel draws a field label in the theme's label type and color and must be composed inside Form.

rows.name: Heading
rows.description: Heading draws a heading in the theme's type set for its level, one level deeper inside each Section.

rows.name: Section
rows.description: Section raises the heading level of every Heading inside it by one, up to six.

rows.name: NumberInput
rows.description: NumberInput edits numeric text with bounded step actions; the second reference has no custom steppers, so their geometry is a Superloom decision.

rows.name: NumberInputSkeleton
rows.description: NumberInputSkeleton composes the field skeleton at the number field's minimum width; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: RadioButtonGroup
rows.description: RadioButtonGroup gathers radio buttons under a legend in a row or a stack, sharing one selection with a single roving tab stop and arrow navigation, and drawing the helper or error message below; the second system has no radio group, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: RadioButtonSkeleton
rows.description: A label-only loading bar at the radio row's height, with no circle.

rows.name: ExpandableSearch
rows.description: ExpandableSearch opens a search field from an icon action; the second system has no expandable search element, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: Search
rows.description: Search is an accessibly named search field with a magnifier and a clear action.

rows.name: SearchSkeleton
rows.description: SearchSkeleton draws the search field's placeholder; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: Slider
rows.description: A bounded numeric value adjusted by a draggable handle, keyboard controls or its optional number field.

rows.name: SliderSkeleton
rows.description: A non-interactive placeholder for a slider label, endpoints and track.

rows.name: HStack
rows.description: HStack is a Stack fixed to a row.

rows.name: Stack
rows.description: Stack lays its children out in a column or a row with a gap from the theme's spacing scale.

rows.name: VStack
rows.description: VStack is a Stack fixed to a column.

rows.name: ToggleSkeleton
rows.description: ToggleSkeleton draws a circle and a short bar as the toggle's placeholder; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: PasswordInput
rows.description: PasswordInput is a text field with an action that reveals or hides its value without changing its label or validation.

rows.name: TextAreaSkeleton
rows.description: TextAreaSkeleton draws a label placeholder and a fixed-height text-area placeholder; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: TextInputSkeleton
rows.description: TextInputSkeleton draws a label placeholder and a field-sized placeholder; the second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: TimePicker
rows.description: TimePicker arranges a text time field and optional compact selects; its second-system values are a Superloom decision and the clock-dial picker is a deferred gap.

rows.name: TimePickerSelect
rows.description: TimePickerSelect draws one compact time option selector and must be composed inside TimePicker; its second-system values are a Superloom decision and the clock-dial picker is a deferred gap.

rows.name: DropdownSkeleton
rows.description: A fixed-height loading placeholder for a dropdown, with an optional label bar.

rows.name: SelectSkeleton
rows.description: A fixed-height loading placeholder for a select field, with an optional label bar.

rows.name: MultiSelect
rows.description: A multiple-choice field with value-keyed checkbox options and a clearable selection count; the second system has no multiple-choice field, so its count member's treatment is a Superloom decision.

rows.name: FilterableMultiSelect
rows.description: A multiple-choice field whose editable query filters options without discarding selections; the second system has no multiple-choice field, so its count member's treatment is a Superloom decision.

rows.name: Layer
rows.description: Layer raises the surface level of everything inside it, so the theme's layered surfaces, fields and borders step up one level, and paints the new level's background when asked; the second system has no layer element, so its level values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: SelectItem
rows.description: SelectItem draws one option of a Select's open list from the theme's list cells; it must be composed inside Select.

rows.name: SelectItemGroup
rows.description: SelectItemGroup draws a group label row above its SelectItems inside a Select's open list and disables them together; it must be composed inside Select; neither reference system draws an option group header of its own, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: ComboBox
rows.description: ComboBox is a single-choice field whose editable input filters the open option list as you type, with a clear action once a value is chosen.

rows.name: FloatingActionButton
rows.description: FloatingActionButton is a raised icon button, optionally extended with a label, for a screen's primary action; its Carbon twin is BottomToolbarPrimaryAction and it has no upstream visual reference, so its values are a Superloom decision.

rows.name: Popover
rows.description: Popover anchors a floating surface with an optional caret to its trigger and leaves its open state to the caller.

rows.name: PopoverContent
rows.description: PopoverContent is the floating body of a Popover; it must be composed inside Popover; it has no upstream visual reference because upstream draws it only inside an open parent, so it is measured through the parent's samples.

rows.name: DefinitionTooltip
rows.description: DefinitionTooltip underlines a term and shows its definition in a small inverse bubble when the term is pressed, or hovered when asked.

rows.name: Toggletip
rows.description: Toggletip pairs a label with an information button that toggles an inverse bubble of text and up to two actions.

rows.name: ToggletipLabel
rows.description: ToggletipLabel is the text beside a Toggletip's button; it must be composed inside Toggletip.

rows.name: ToggletipButton
rows.description: ToggletipButton is the information button that opens and closes a Toggletip; it must be composed inside Toggletip.

rows.name: ToggletipContent
rows.description: ToggletipContent is the body text of a Toggletip's bubble; it must be composed inside Toggletip; it has no upstream visual reference because upstream draws it only inside an open parent, so it is measured through the parent's samples.

rows.name: ToggletipActions
rows.description: ToggletipActions lays out a Toggletip's link and button at the bubble's base; it must be composed inside Toggletip and has no upstream visual reference.

rows.name: TagSet
rows.description: TagSet shows as many tags as fit on one row and gathers the rest behind a +n tag that lists them, with a searchable dialog when there are many.

rows.name: Tab
rows.description: Tab draws one item of a tab list - its label, optional icon and secondary line, and its selected and disabled states; it must be composed inside Tabs.

rows.name: TabList
rows.description: TabList lays out a row of tabs with the selection indicator, keyboard movement, optional close buttons and overflow scrolling; it must be composed inside Tabs.

rows.name: TabPanel
rows.description: TabPanel holds the content for one tab and is labelled by it; it must be composed inside Tabs; no upstream visual reference.

rows.name: TabPanels
rows.description: TabPanels shows the panel of the selected tab and keeps the others linked but hidden; it must be composed inside Tabs; no upstream visual reference.

rows.name: IconTab
rows.description: IconTab is an icon-only tab whose name appears in a tooltip.

rows.name: TabsVertical
rows.description: TabsVertical lists tabs in a column beside their panels, with scroll fades when the list is long.

rows.name: TabListVertical
rows.description: TabListVertical is the column of tabs inside TabsVertical; it must be composed inside Tabs; no upstream visual reference.

rows.name: TabsSkeleton
rows.description: TabsSkeleton draws the placeholder shape of a tab list while its content loads.

rows.name: ContentSwitcher
rows.description: ContentSwitcher is a row of segments where exactly one is selected, for switching between views of the same content.

rows.name: Switch
rows.description: Switch is one text segment of a ContentSwitcher; no upstream visual reference.

rows.name: IconSwitch
rows.description: IconSwitch is one icon segment of a ContentSwitcher whose name appears in a tooltip; it must be composed inside ContentSwitcher; no upstream visual reference.

rows.name: MenuButton
rows.description: MenuButton is a button that opens a Menu of actions below or above it, its chevron turning while the menu is open.

rows.name: MenuItem
rows.description: MenuItem is one action of a Menu, with an optional icon and shortcut, a danger kind and a submenu of further items; it must be composed inside Menu.

rows.name: MenuItemDivider
rows.description: MenuItemDivider is a rule that separates groups of items in a Menu; it must be composed inside Menu.

rows.name: MenuItemGroup
rows.description: MenuItemGroup names a run of a Menu's items for assistive technology without drawing a heading; it must be composed inside Menu.

rows.name: MenuItemRadioGroup
rows.description: MenuItemRadioGroup is a named set of Menu items of which exactly one is selected and marked; it must be composed inside Menu.

rows.name: MenuItemSelectable
rows.description: MenuItemSelectable is a Menu item that toggles on and off and shows a mark while it is on; it must be composed inside Menu.

rows.name: OverflowMenu
rows.description: OverflowMenu is a square icon button that opens a panel of options joined to it, for actions that do not fit beside the content.

rows.name: OverflowMenuItem
rows.description: OverflowMenuItem is one option row of an OverflowMenu, with an optional rule above it and a danger kind; it must be composed inside OverflowMenu.

rows.name: CopyButton
rows.description: CopyButton is an icon button whose tooltip confirms a copy for a moment after it is pressed.

rows.name: SkipToContent
rows.description: A visually hidden link that appears on keyboard focus and moves focus past the page's navigation to its main content; web-only, because native screens have no tab order to skip.

rows.name: ComposedModal
rows.description: ComposedModal is the framed dialog on its own scrim layer composing ModalHeader, ModalBody and an optional ModalFooter - passive without one - with Escape, focus trapping and outside-press dismissal.

rows.name: ModalHeader
rows.description: ModalHeader is the header band of a ComposedModal - the eyebrow label, the heading and the close seat; it must be composed inside ComposedModal, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through ComposedModal's samples.

rows.name: ModalBody
rows.description: ModalBody is the content region of a ComposedModal - the prose body, scrollable on demand and gutterless for a form; it must be composed inside ComposedModal, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through ComposedModal's samples.

rows.name: ModalFooter
rows.description: ModalFooter is the action row of a ComposedModal - a primary action plus a secondary action or two; it must be composed inside ComposedModal, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through ComposedModal's samples.

rows.name: InlineNotification
rows.description: InlineNotification is the status band that sits in the page flow: a marker and kind glyph, a title, an optional subtitle and a close button.

rows.name: ActionableNotification
rows.description: ActionableNotification is a status notification carrying an action: the `inline` form seats a ghost action beside the title and subtitle, the toast form a tertiary-inverse action below them with a close button.

rows.name: Callout
rows.description: Callout is the persistent inline message - marker, kind glyph, title and subtitle with the ghost action, no close button and no dialog role.

rows.name: NotificationActionButton
rows.description: NotificationActionButton is a notification's action button - the inline ghost or the toast tertiary-inverse form; it must be composed inside ActionableNotification, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through the notification's samples.

rows.name: Breadcrumb
rows.description: Breadcrumb draws the page trail: a row of links separated by slashes, the current page unlinked and an `{ overflow: [...] }` entry collapsing to a menu, with a trailing slash unless `noTrailingSlash`.

rows.name: BreadcrumbItem
rows.description: BreadcrumbItem is one entry of a Breadcrumb's trail - a link, the current page or the overflow-menu seat; it must be composed inside Breadcrumb, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through Breadcrumb's samples.

rows.name: BreadcrumbSkeleton
rows.description: BreadcrumbSkeleton draws the breadcrumb's loading form - `items` shimmer bars at the breadcrumb size with the trail's separators and `noTrailingSlash` dropping the last.

rows.name: Accordion
rows.description: Accordion stacks headed sections that open and close independently, each with a chevron and a divider rule.

rows.name: AccordionItem
rows.description: AccordionItem is one headed section of an Accordion with its chevron, title and collapsible content; it must be composed inside Accordion and has no upstream visual reference.

rows.name: AccordionSkeleton
rows.description: AccordionSkeleton draws the placeholder shape of an accordion, one section open, while its content loads.

rows.name: UnorderedList
rows.description: A bulleted list with en-dash markers; nested lists indent and mark squares.

rows.name: OrderedList
rows.description: A numbered list with `n.` markers (lower-latin `a.` nested; `native` uses the browser's decimal marker).

rows.name: ListItem
rows.description: One row of a text list with its marker; it must be composed inside UnorderedList or OrderedList, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through the lists' samples.

rows.name: ContainedList
rows.description: ContainedList is a labelled list of rows inside a container, with a sticky header, an optional search and rulers between rows.

rows.name: ContainedListItem
rows.description: ContainedListItem is one row of a ContainedList, optionally pressable, with an icon and an end action; it must be composed inside ContainedList, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through the list's samples.

rows.name: Card
rows.description: Card is a productive card with a header, a body and actions in its header or footer.

rows.name: EmptyState
rows.description: EmptyState is a title, supporting text, an action and a link under an optional illustration.

rows.name: Column
rows.description: Column is one cell of the layout grid, spanning a number of the breakpoint's columns with the gutter halves the family context carries; it must be composed inside Grid or Row, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through the Grid and Row samples.

rows.name: Grid
rows.description: Grid is the layout grid that holds rows of columns sized per breakpoint.

rows.name: Row
rows.description: Row is one row of a Grid; it must be composed inside Grid.

rows.name: Pagination
rows.description: Pagination is a bar that pages through a list, with a page-size select, item counts and previous and next buttons.

rows.name: PaginationNav
rows.description: PaginationNav is a row of page buttons with overflow pickers and previous and next buttons.

rows.name: PaginationSkeleton
rows.description: PaginationSkeleton is the loading placeholder of a Pagination bar.

rows.name: RadioTile
rows.description: RadioTile is a selectable tile that acts as one radio option inside a TileGroup.

rows.name: ClickableTile
rows.description: ClickableTile is a tile that acts as one link or press target, with an optional corner icon.

rows.name: ExpandableTile
rows.description: ExpandableTile is a tile that reveals its below-the-fold content when expanded from its chevron.

rows.name: SelectableTile
rows.description: SelectableTile is a tile that toggles its own selection like a checkbox, marked in its corner.

rows.name: Tile
rows.description: Tile is a container on the layer that groups related content.

rows.name: TileGroup
rows.description: TileGroup is a labelled group of RadioTiles holding one selected value.

rows.name: DatePicker
rows.description: DatePicker picks a date or a date range from a calendar under one or two date inputs.

rows.name: DatePickerInput
rows.description: DatePickerInput is one date field of a DatePicker - the label, the text field at the width the picker's type assigns and the calendar icon; it must be composed inside DatePicker, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through DatePicker's samples.

rows.name: DatePickerSkeleton
rows.description: DatePickerSkeleton is the loading placeholder of a DatePicker: a label bar and one or two input bars.

rows.name: Filename
rows.description: Filename is a component in the FileUploader family.

rows.name: FileUploader
rows.description: FileUploader is a component in the FileUploader family.

rows.name: FileUploaderButton
rows.description: FileUploaderButton is a component in the FileUploader family; it must be composed inside FileUploader.

rows.name: FileUploaderDropContainer
rows.description: FileUploaderDropContainer is a component in the FileUploader family; it must be composed inside FileUploader.

rows.name: FileUploaderItem
rows.description: FileUploaderItem is a component in the FileUploader family; it must be composed inside FileUploader.

rows.name: FileUploaderSkeleton
rows.description: FileUploaderSkeleton is a component in the FileUploader family.

rows.name: PageHeader
rows.description: PageHeader is the page header: breadcrumbs, a title row with actions, subtitle and tags, collapsing on scroll.

rows.name: Tearsheet
rows.description: Tearsheet is a large dialog for a focused task: a header, an optional influencer panel, the main content and a row of actions.

rows.name: TreeNode
rows.description: TreeNode is one row of a TreeView - an expandable parent or a selectable leaf with an optional icon, indented by its depth; it must be composed inside TreeView, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through the tree's samples.

rows.name: TreeView
rows.description: TreeView is a hierarchical list of nodes that expand, collapse and select, one at a time or several, walked by the arrow keys under an optional visible label.

rows.name: Content
rows.description: Content is a component in the Header family.

rows.name: Header
rows.description: Header is a component in the Header family.

rows.name: HeaderContainer
rows.description: HeaderContainer is a component in the Header family.

rows.name: HeaderGlobalAction
rows.description: HeaderGlobalAction is a component in the Header family; it must be composed inside Header.

rows.name: HeaderGlobalBar
rows.description: HeaderGlobalBar is a component in the Header family; it must be composed inside Header.

rows.name: HeaderMenu
rows.description: HeaderMenu is a component in the Header family; it must be composed inside Header.

rows.name: HeaderMenuButton
